meta.description: Hireel is a video-first talent marketplace for Lebanon and the GCC. Candidates record a short intro video for free; employers discover talent in a reels-style feed and send intro requests.
meta.title: Hireel – Video-first hiring in Lebanon & the GCC
meta.ogAlt: Hireel – Your next opportunity starts with a video.

home.headline: Your Experience Deserves to Be Seen.
home.lead: Show who you are beyond your CV. Discover opportunities through video, or find exceptional talent in seconds.
home.demoNote: Some profiles shown are demo profiles.
home.cand1Sub: Name, headline, location, skills and experience. About two minutes.
home.cand2Sub: Answer three guided questions. Add a second video in Arabic or French if you like.
home.cand3: Say yes to the right employers
home.cand3Sub: Companies send intro requests. Your phone, email and CV stay private until you accept.
home.emp1Sub: Swipe through intro videos and filter by industry or video language. No account needed.
home.emp2Sub: Save candidates, open full profiles and send intro requests.
home.emp3Sub: Candidates choose what to share with you: phone, email or CV.
home.industriesTitle: Talent across Lebanon and the GCC
home.whyTitle: A CV lists facts. A video shows how you communicate.
home.why1Sub: Hear how a candidate explains their work in 60 seconds, before booking a call.
home.why2Sub: No likes, no follower counts, no popularity ranking. Filters cover job-related details only.
home.why3Sub: Contact details are never public. Candidates decide who sees them.
home.plansTitle: Start free. Upgrade when you hire more.
home.planCv: {n} CV and contact requests per month
home.plansNote: Online payment isn’t available yet. The Hireel team switches companies to Premium on request.
home.faq2A: You choose: everyone who visits Hireel, or only signed-in employers. You can unpublish at any time.
home.faq3: Do I have to appear on camera?
home.faq3A: No. You can create a text-only profile instead.
home.faq4: When does an employer get my phone or email?
home.faq4A: Only after you accept their request and choose what to share.
home.faq5: Can I use Hireel in Arabic?
home.faq5A: Yes. Tap the globe icon at the top to switch between English and Arabic.
home.finalBody: Create your profile and record your first video today.
home.heroNote: Free for candidates · Employers watch free, no account needed
home.float2: Up to 2 videos, any of EN / AR / FR
home.faq6A: Yes. During our launch, everything is free for employers too: browsing reels, search, saving candidates and sending intro requests. No payment details needed.
